claims.text: Many reviewers describe the hair as soft and silky, with several praising its quality and value.
A common complaint is that the bundles are thin, sparse, or transparent.
Several reviewers report the hair is a human/synthetic blend or turns synthetic-like, contrary to expectations.
Shedding is mentioned by multiple reviewers, both as minimal and as a problem.
Some reviewers praise the seller's customer service and willingness to resolve issues.
